findings.title: Merged PR comment helpers are on the wrong class
findings.body: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template and get_environment_info were added to CommitContextIntegration, but GitHubPRCommentWorkflow and GitlabPRCommentWorkflow call them as self methods. Those workflows subclass PRCommentWorkflow, not CommitContextIntegration, so get_comment_body will raise AttributeError and suspect-issue PR comments will fail. The helper also calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title, while _truncate_title is defined only on CommitContextIntegration, so even a direct call would AttributeError.

findings.title: Error timestamps from nodestore are not comparable to breadcrumb timestamps
findings.body: fetch_error_details copies data.get("timestamp") straight into ErrorEvent. Nodestore event payloads store timestamp as an ISO string, not a float. gen_request_data then compares that value with segment event timestamps using <. A string-vs-number comparison raises TypeError inside the paginator callback and the summarize endpoint returns 500 whenever error context is enabled. Tests only pass because they store a numeric timestamp. The same loop also zips error_ids with events.values(), so a missing nodestore key drops alignment and attaches the wrong title/message/timestamp to an event id.

findings.title: Table widget flag renders an empty table
findings.body: When organizations:use-table-widget-visualization is on, tableResultComponent ignores result.data, fields, and metadata and renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns={[]} and tableData.data=[]. Every dashboard table widget becomes blank instead of showing the query result. The flag is a user-visible switch, not a dead code path.

findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only removed while searching
findings.body: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES (is_segment, project_id, received) is applied only inside the searchQuery branch. With an empty search the full attribute list is returned, so those fields stay visible. Typing a query then hides them even when the name matches, which is the opposite of a hide-always filter and makes search results inconsistent with the unfiltered tree.

findings.title: 60s deadline can skip SSO identity refresh for a day
findings.body: check_auth_identities now has processing_deadline_duration=60 but still refreshes up to chunk_size (100) identities sequentially, each via an external provider call. check_auth already stamps last_synced=now on the whole chunk before this task runs. If the worker hits the 60s deadline mid-chunk, the remaining identities are not refreshed and will not be selected again until the next AUTH_CHECK_INTERVAL (~24h), so SSO validity can stay stale.

findings.title: Assemble analytics runs before auth/feature checks and can 500 the upload
findings.body: analytics.record(..., user_id=request.user.id) now runs before the organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble feature check and before request body validation. This endpoint is used by org auth tokens (is_org_auth_token_auth later in the handler). If request.user is anonymous or has no id, accessing .id raises and CI assemble uploads fail with 500 even when the feature is enabled and the body is valid. Failures are also recorded as successful assemble events when the feature is off.
